title: Applications are invited for the post of Digital Media Designer.

source.name: Department of Economics, Panjab University, Chandigarh

text:

Qualification:
Educational Qualification (Please attach one set of attested copies)

FULL TEXT:
Applications are invited from the eligible candidates for the following temporary posts in Research
Project entitled “Climate, Health and Air Monitoring Project”. Posts are purely on contract basis and
co-terminus with the term period of the project.
Post: Digital Media Designer (number of post- 2)
Qualification:
Essential: 12th pass having working experience in Graphics design/animation
Or
Diploma / Degree either in Graphic Designing/ animation / allied discipline or having
studied any above as one of subject/paper in course
Desirable:
Having working experience in Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe after Effect and
related softwares
 Candidate should provide at least 1 recommendation letter and work experience in
same field.
a) Salary: Rs. 31000/- per month (fixed)
b) Job Description:
 A self-motivated, multi-skilled candidate is sought to join the project having good
knowledge of Graphic Design Skills, brainstorming creative designing ideas, Good
interpersonal skills, Ability to Work in Strict Deadlines, Researching and preparing
rough drafts.
 Developing and designing layouts, concepts, graphics for company logos, product
illustrations and websites, suggesting improvements after reviewing final layouts
 Able to understand brief provided and create high quality visual within given
timelines
Candidate should be available for immediate joining, if selected
Applications along with bio-data and attested copies of certificates and work experience, publications
etc should reach to the undersigned latest by 14 October 2023 before 2.00 pm in room no 227,
Department of Environment Studies, Panjab University Chandigarh.
Candidate should also fill the google form https://forms.gle/gTJEPPenwCcQsUAB8 before submitting
application with document through email. The interview date and time will be informed through email
to shortlisted candidates. Interview may be held online/offline. No TA/DA will be paid to attend the
interview. The rules and regulations as laid down by Panjab University and/or funding agency will govern the
selected candidate.
(Dr Suman Mor)
Department of Environment Studies
Panjab University, Chandigarh (INDIA)
Dr Suman Mor
Professor & Principal Investigator E. Mail: sumanmor@pu.ac.in
